params.justification: Observed consistent ~3.2-3.5% shortfalls across all credit card payments in this group, all flagged as shipping-adjacent (shortfall_eq_shipping=true). Current R4.max_percent of 2.9% is below the observed pattern. Increasing to 3.5% accommodates the full range while R4.must_fit_shipping=true ensures these match legitimate shipping costs rather than processor fees.

summary: Amend policy R4.max_percent from 2.9 to 3.5 to accommodate the consistent ~3.2-3.5% shipping-adjacent shortfalls observed across all credit card receipts in this group, which are currently being rejected but should be accepted as legitimate shipping cost variations.
